ema_tuple_ordered.meaning: getEMAs() returns the tuple in the stated positional order spotEMA(0), fastEMA(1), slowEMA(2), eonsEMA(3), medianTick(4)

twap_tick.meaning: TWAP tick value produced by twapEMA() and consumed at the solvency checkpoint
twap_tick.checkpoint: after twapEMA() computation, at solvency classification

intended_twap_tick.meaning: intended TWAP tick 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons consistent with getEMAs() interpretation

solvency_classification_correct.meaning: solvency classification at the TWAP checkpoint matches the classification that the intended TWAP tick would produce

assumptions: getEMAs() tuple ordering is fixed as stated and twapEMA() unpacks it positionally
The intended TWAP is the weighted combination 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons as stated by the security intent
Solvency classification is a function of the TWAP tick used at the checkpoint

unresolved.description: The report does not give numeric EMA values or the exact solvency-grid price-point formula, so the equality twap_tick == intended_twap_tick is symbolic and the solvency misclassification is represented by a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric grid relation

limitations: The intended TWAP weighted formula is encoded as (6*fast + 3*slow + eons)/10 via cross-multiplied integer operands; the report states the 0.6/0.3/0.1 weights but no concrete EMA values
Solvency classification correctness is a report-grounded Boolean because the report does not define the four-point solvency grid numerically
Only impact_solvency is formalized; stale-guard and liquidation-pricing impacts are out of scope for this plan
